Companion Animal Travel Desk Guidance
The purpose of this section is to set clear expectations for customers planning travel with companion animals.

The Companion Animal Travel Desk at Aurelia Skyways is guided by a senior coordinator who oversees daily service decisions to keep arrangements consistent and humane. Our trained staff provide patient attention throughout the intake, handling, and coordination process, and they record service changes in the desk ledger so that every update can be trusted. When a traveler contacts the desk, we treat each case with care, using the same steady approach regardless of destination complexity.

For rabbits, the travel booking must comply with the combined limit for the pet and crate, as defined for standard ordinary sentences by our internal system, so please ensure the crate is included when you review your planned setup. Milolet will receive the same respectful care during preparation and check-in coordination, and you can be assured staff will work carefully with your documents and any approved plan. If Ben Ibrahim or Nikhil Nakamura are included in your itinerary, the desk will still apply the same criteria, timelines, and documentation checks with equal diligence.

Service changes may be recommended when operational considerations arise, including adjustments to handling notes or processing steps; these changes are documented in the ledger to maintain continuity. Please arrive with your companion prepared according to the approved arrangement, and allow time for staff assistance at each stage. If any uncertainty remains, contact the Companion Animal Travel Desk for prompt guidance and support.
